title: BrainerLab experiment record
description: Schema for experiments/NL-EXP-######.json as built by engine/neurolab_engine/experiment.py (experiment_to_dict) and backend/app/main.py (simulate_experiment). Field-name mapping to the generic proposal: circuit -> dataset_id, circuit_version -> dataset_version, engine model -> model/model_version, interventions -> stimulus + manipulations_virtual_only, outputs -> results. Validation of incoming payloads is done by validate_experiment(); unknown models, parameters, neurons or edges are rejected with 422 and never silently ignored. Only experiments/NL-EXP-000001.json (reference) is tracked in git; all other runs are local runtime state (see .gitignore).

experiment_id.description: Sequential id from new_experiment_id(); reference is NL-EXP-000001

parameters.description: Model parameters; keys must exist in the model defaults (docs/models.md), e.g. {} uses all defaults

manipulations_virtual_only.description: Virtual manipulations touch the MODEL only, never biology (= part of generic 'interventions')

seed.description: RNG seed. Same dataset + model + parameters + seed = byte-identical spike trains (tested).

author.description: Optional campus display name that created the run

results.description: Outputs (= generic 'outputs'); present only after POST /api/simulations. GET /api/results/{id} returns 409 before that.

spikes.description: Map neuron id -> list of spike times in ms

summary.description: Per-neuron counts/rates, totals, and behavior_proxy (model proxy, never animal behaviour)

meta.description: model, model_version, duration_ms, seed, n_edges_used, electrical_edges_excluded

behavior_delta.description: Delta of the MODEL behaviour proxy, not animal behaviour
